notes.title: Version 1.7.0
notes.content:
A few corrections were made in some of the high levels (91-100).
The Settings page does not support changing the language. English is the only language supported at this time.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The demo version of the game is available again.  The free demo has 10 levels. The full game has 100 levels.
[*] Improvements were made to the game to support screen layouts with aspect ratios 3:2 and 4:3.
[*] Settings screen option buttons have been resized. It was too easy to click "Game Reset" accidentally.
[*] A problem has been fixed for players with default language of Korean. No game text was being displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Thump Available on Settings Screen
notes.content:
For more fun at Halloween, choose the Halloween style of Thump. 

Version 1.5.1 includes special Thump for Halloween. Go to the Settings page if you would like to change the Thump style for the game.

notes.title: Better Support for Game Controllers and Keyboard
notes.content:
Keyboard and game controller support has been added. Before this update, you had to use a mouse to play the game.  Colors of buttons and UI elements have changed so you can easily see which button is will be selected.

WASD keys and arrow keys work for moving from button to button on the screen. Use the Enter key to click the select UI element. With a gamepad controller, use the A button to click the highlighted UI element on the screen.

notes.title: Version 1.4.0
notes.content: After losing a game, you receive advice and hints about what you could do better. Prior to this update, no advice was offered if you chose to pause the game and quit before the final turn. Doing that meant you missed valuable tips on how to improve your play. This update corrects that problem.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
New Thump styles have been added.  Go to the Settings screen to change the Thump style.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
The demo version of the game has been updated. Hope you like the changes.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[b]Look-and-feel[/b]
The score panels for Hop and Skip are now positioned to the left and right of the game board. Previously, both were on the left side of the board. The game board itself is smaller and positioned in the center of the screen.

There is now a new background scene for the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41254352/f79db1ff8529e4205e9b4e8d4d686d4042f93e4f.png[/img]

[b]Initial Jump Power[/b]
If you get stuck on a level for more than two games, you will see a popup window that gives you the option to replay the level with different starting conditions. Instead of the standard initial jump of three squares, you may choose to start the game with an initial jump of one or two. You may find that a different start is all you need to complete a level.

[b]Exit Button[/b]
There are two places where you can exit the game. One is on the Levels screen and the other is on the Play screen. Look for the new exit button on the lower right corner of the screen.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. The problem with the starting positions of the rabbits for Level 8 has been corrected. Both Hop and Skip were starting on the same square.
2. There were a few places where popup score values were being obscured by images on the screen.

notes.title: Demo Game
notes.content:
A demo version of the Hop Skip and Thump is now available. The demo version consists of the first 10 levels of the full game. All features are enabled.

Enjoy the game ... but do watch out for the red Thump monsters.

Playtest for Hop Skip and Thump has begun.
